general.closeAfterLaunchHint: A closed launcher writes no session history and sends no Discord status - both are read from Roblox's log while Nulltrap is running. Leave it open if you want either.
general.autoUpdateHint: Checks the version before every launch and downloads what changed. While the launcher is open it also checks the channel every four hours, so a new build is already there when you press Play.
general.multiInstance: Ask before a second Roblox client
general.multiInstanceHint: Running several clients at once is disputed under Roblox's terms. Nulltrap will not enable it silently.
graphics.unlockFpsHint: Roblox caps the client at 240 frames a second. This lifts the cap and sets your own number - 9999 means as many as the machine can draw. Two switches do it: one sets the target, the other removes the 240 ceiling.
graphics.textureQualityHint: Forces a texture detail level instead of letting Roblox pick one. Higher looks better and costs more memory.
graphics.msaaHint: Anti-aliasing. Softens the jagged staircase on diagonal edges. More samples look smoother and cost frames.
graphics.dpiHint: Renders at the monitor's real resolution on a scaled display. Sharper, and heavier.
shortcuts.desktopHint: Created and removed as you change this.
deployment.channelHint: Leave as production unless you know why you are changing it. An unknown channel simply fails to launch, it does not fall back.
storage.keepCacheHint: Packages are cached under their checksum, so an update only fetches what actually changed.
about.unofficial: An unofficial project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Roblox Corporation.
about.notDoHint: It does not inject into, modify or read the memory of the Roblox client. It does not bypass anti-cheat. It does not try to work around the FastFlag allowlist - Roblox has said that editing flags in memory carries consequences.
about.sourceHint: Releases are published only in this repository.
about.removeHint: Unregisters the handlers, removes shortcuts and deletes the downloaded client.
setup.whatIsHint: It replaces the Roblox bootstrapper. It downloads the official Roblox client from Roblox's own servers, unpacks it into your user profile and starts it. Nothing is installed for other users and no administrator rights are needed.
setup.notDoHint: It does not inject into, modify or read the memory of the Roblox client. It does not bypass anti-cheat. It does not try to work around the FastFlag allowlist - Roblox has said that editing flags in memory carries consequences, and Nulltrap will not do it.
setup.responsibleHint: Nulltrap is an unofficial project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Roblox Corporation. It is provided as is, under the MIT licence, with no warranty. You are responsible for how you use it.
setup.agree: I have read the above and want to continue
setup.playerHint: About 200 MB to download, roughly 320 MB once unpacked. Needed to play.
setup.studioSizeHint: Considerably larger and only needed if you build experiences. It can be downloaded later from the launcher.
setup.nothingHint: That is fine. Nulltrap installs itself now and downloads the client the first time you press Launch.
setup.nextHint: The Play button on the Roblox website opens Nulltrap, which checks for a client update and starts Roblox. You can change any of this later in Settings.
general.languageHint: Applies straight away. Windows already open are reloaded.

page.about.title: About Nulltrap
page.about.subtitle: Version, source and removal.
graphics.fpsAllowed: This setting is on Roblox's allowlist and applies.
graphics.fpsUnlisted: Roblox's September 2025 allowlist announcement did not include this setting, so the client may ignore it. Every other launcher uses exactly these two flags, so if it works there it works here. Check with Shift+F5 in game after launching.
language.helpHint: Translations live in two JSON files in the repository. Fixing a phrase is editing one line and opening a pull request.
page.launcher.title: Settings
page.launcher.subtitle: The launcher itself: its language, where it lives, and removing it.
launcher.repairHint: Re-registers the protocol handlers and rebuilds the shortcuts. Use this if the Play button stopped opening Nulltrap or a shortcut points nowhere.
graphics.apiHint: Which renderer Roblox asks Windows for. Vulkan can be faster on AMD, D3D11 is the safe default. Change it only if you have a reason.
graphics.grassHint: How far grass keeps being drawn. Cutting it back is one of the cheapest ways to gain frames outdoors.
settings.savedNote: They take effect the next time the game starts
page.presence.title: Discord
page.presence.subtitle: What your friends see while you play.
presence.enableHint: Sets your Discord status to the experience you are in. It needs no setup on your side: Nulltrap sends the status under its own Discord application. Everything shown is read from Roblox's own log and its public games API, never from your account.
presence.button: Add a link to the game
presence.notConfigured: This build carries no Discord application, so there is nothing to send the status under.
presence.waiting: Waiting for you to join a game.
presence.headline: Top line
presence.headlineHint: Pick as many as you want; they are joined together.
presence.sublineHint: Same again: everything ticked is shown, separated by a bar.
presence.elapsed: Count the time you have played
page.versions.title: Versions
page.versions.subtitle: Download Roblox and Studio yourself, before you need them.
versions.confirmRemove: Remove this build from disk? The next launch will download it again.
versions.idleHint: Downloading here means the next launch starts straight away. It keeps going if you close this window.
page.activity.title: Activity
page.activity.subtitle: Where your Roblox hours went, read from its own log.
activity.favouritesHint: Ranked by the time spent, not by how often.
activity.recentHint: Sessions shorter than twenty seconds are left out. Nothing leaves this machine.
activity.confirmClear: Forget every session recorded so far?
activity.nothingYet: Nothing recorded yet. Play something and come back.
activity.unknownGame: An experience Roblox would not name
page.mods.title: Mods
page.mods.subtitle: Your own files, laid over the Roblox client after every update.
mods.enableHint: Off puts every original file back and leaves the client untouched. Your files stay in the folder.
mods.filesHint: Put a file at the same path it has inside the client, and it replaces that file. Nulltrap keeps the original and puts it back if you remove yours.
mods.noClient: Roblox is not downloaded yet, so there is nothing to lay them over.
mods.readyFor: Will be applied to {0} on the next launch.
mods.examplesHint: The client's own layout, so a file at one of these replaces what Roblox ships.
page.flags.title: FastFlag editor
page.flags.subtitle: A tick under Preset means Nulltrap sets the flag itself from Graphics; a cross means you added it by hand.
flags.yourRisk: These are yours, and so is what they do. A wrong switch can break rendering, stop the client starting, or be treated by Roblox as something you did to their client - Nulltrap does not check what a flag means and does not answer for it.
flags.addHint: The name as Roblox spells it, then the value. True and False for switches, a number for the rest.
flags.badName: A name is letters, digits and underscores only.
flags.badPrefix: A flag name starts with one of: {0}
setup.handlersHint: Play on the website and Studio both come to Nulltrap from now on. It is set up for you and stays that way; nothing to switch.
about.flagsRiskHint: The FastFlags page writes whatever you type straight into the client's own settings file. Nulltrap does not check what a flag means, does not test it, and does not answer for what it does to your client or your account - that is yours, and adding one is you accepting it.
flags.readyWhatHint: Everything here is on the allowlist Roblox published in September 2025, so the client will act on it. Anything you set on this tab shows up in the editor as well.
flags.systemOwned: Set from another page, and changed there.
ready.skyGrayHint: Replaces the sky and its lighting with flat grey. Ugly, and one of the cheapest frames you will ever buy.
ready.pauseVoxelizerHint: Stops the client recomputing voxel lighting as things move. Shadows go stale; the frame time stops spiking.
ready.qualityHint: Overrides the whole quality ladder with one step of it. 1 is the cheapest, 21 the most expensive.
ready.altEnterHint: Fullscreen switching stops going through Windows. Fixes the black screen some machines get on Alt+Enter.
ready.grassMotionHint: How much the grass sways. Zero stops it dead.
ready.geometryHint: How far away solid-modelled parts keep their detail. Shorter is cheaper.
presence.richPresenceHint: The desktop Discord app has to be running. Nulltrap talks to it over a local pipe; nothing is sent anywhere else.
presence.accountHint: Puts your Roblox name and avatar in the corner of the status, read from the user id in Roblox's own log.
presence.join: Let people join through the status
presence.joinHint: Adds a Join server button that opens the exact server you are on. Anyone who can see your status can use it.
presence.customHint: Choose what the status says and which parts appear.
page.news.title: News
page.news.subtitle: What changed, what is coming, and whether you are up to date.
news.current: You are on {0}, the newest there is.
news.noReleases: You are on {0}. Nothing has been released yet, so there is nothing to compare against.
news.newVersionHint: Published {0}. Updating is still done by hand; that changes soon.
news.plannedHint: Next in line, and honest about the order changing.
news.changesHint: Newest first, in the launcher's own words rather than commit titles.
page.home.title: Home
page.home.subtitle: Your account, what to play, and where the hours went.
home.recommendedHint: Picked from what Roblox is busy with right now, leaning towards what you already play.
home.recommendedEmpty: Roblox did not answer. Try again in a minute.
home.noAccountHint: Play once and Nulltrap will pick your profile up from the Roblox log.
flags.emptyNone: Nothing here yet. Add your own, or switch one on under Graphics.
flags.copyFailed: Windows would not give up the clipboard
flags.confirmRemoveAll: Delete every flag you added by hand?
flags.emptyPresetOnly: Only preset flags are set. Switch them on above to see them.
flags.name: Name
flags.jsonHint: An object of name and value, the way the client settings file keeps them.
flags.badJson: This is not an object of flags and values.
graphics.ownHint: Kept in Roblox's own file. Change them with the client closed - Roblox writes the file again when it exits.
graphics.flagHint: Nulltrap passes these to the client on launch.
graphics.levelHint: The same ten steps the in-game slider has.
graphics.maxQualityHint: Roblox stops lowering quality when frames drop.
graphics.vignetteHint: The darkening at the edges of the screen.
graphics.reducedMotionHint: Calms the animation in the client's own interface.
graphics.capHint: Roblox's own cap, the one the in-game menu sets.
graphics.maximisedHint: In windowed mode, open the window at full size.
graphics.voiceHint: How loud other people are in voice chat.
graphics.partyHint: Voice inside a party, apart from the game.
graphics.qualityModeHint: Let Roblox pick the level, or hold the one you set.
graphics.optimizationHint: What the engine gives up first when it runs short.
graphics.transparencyHint: Roblox's own panels: see-through, or solid for contrast.
graphics.uiNavigationHint: The backslash key enters and leaves navigation mode.
graphics.performanceStatsHint: The frame and memory readout in the corner.
graphics.microProfilerHint: The engine's own frame profiler on screen.
graphics.playerListHint: The list of who is on the server.
graphics.chatHint: Show the chat window when you join.
graphics.playerNamesHint: Names above characters. A game may override this.
graphics.badgesHint: Whether other people see your badges.
graphics.sensitivityHint: How far the camera turns for the same mouse movement.
graphics.vrHint: Start in a headset when one is connected.
graphics.ownWhileOpen: Roblox is open right now - it rewrites this file when it exits, so save with the client closed.
remove.title: Remove Nulltrap
remove.question: What should go with it?
remove.launcherOnlyHint: Settings, playtime history, mods and your FastFlags stay where they are, and a later install finds them again. The downloaded Roblox clients go either way - nothing is left to run them.
remove.everything: The launcher and everything it kept
remove.everythingHint: Settings, history, mods and flags as well. Roblox's own settings are not touched - they are the client's, not ours.
remove.gone: Nulltrap is removed and will close now. What you set up is still on the disk.
remove.goneAll: Nulltrap is removed along with everything it kept, and will close now.
